rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice before a noun when something was not anticipated.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 gu2 m4 dou2 ge3 git3 gwo2

rows.note: Use this when describing an unexpected or surprising result, event, or situation, especially predicatively.

example.jyutping: go3 git3 gwo2 zan1 hai6 ji3 ngoi6

rows.note: Use this for something genuinely unforeseeable, often with a slightly more emphatic or polished tone than the colloquial construction.

example.english: Nobody expected them to win; it was truly unexpected.
example.traditional: 冇人估到佢會贏，真係意想不到。
example.jyutping: mou5 jan4 gu2 dou2 keoi5 wui5 jeng4 zan1 hai6 ji3 soeng2 bat1 dou2
